copy.headline: Investigation underway after 3 injured in Fort Worth shooting
copy.caption:
Fort Worth police are investigating a shooting that sent three people to a hospital Wednesday. According to preliminary information from police, East Division officers were dispatched to a shooting on Avenue J, just south of East Rosedale Street.

Officers had received a report that a group of people was fighting and a gunshot was heard. The severity of their injuries is unknown.

story.title: Investigation underway after 3 injured in Fort Worth shooting
story.summary: Fort Worth police are investigating a shooting that sent three people to a hospital Wednesday. Here’s what we know. Fort Worth Police are investigating a shooting in which three people were injured in southeast Fort Worth. According to preliminary information from police, East Division officers were dispatched to a shooting on Avenue J, just south of East Rosedale Street. Officers had received a report that a group of people was fighting and a gunshot was heard. Fort Worth Police said three people were found with gunshot wounds and taken to the hospital. The severity of their injuries is unknown. Investigators expect to release additional details as they learn more. Check back and refresh this page for the latest updates.
